subject_uz: Qon xizmati markazlari uchun tibbiy uskunalar: 27 ta qon komponentlari muzlatgichi va 30 ta past haroratli (-40 C gacha) muzlatkich

requirements.summary_uz: Past haroratli muzlatkichning umumiy hajmi kamida 590 litr bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The low-temperature freezer must have a total volume of at least 590 litres.

requirements.summary_uz: Muzlatkich elektr o'chganda haroratni kamida 2,5 soat ushlab turishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The freezer must hold temperature for at least 2.5 hours after a power cut.
requirements.quote: Время удержания температуры при отключении питания Не менее 2.5 ч

requirements.summary_uz: Qon komponentlari sovutgichining foydali hajmi kamida 510 litr bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The blood-component refrigerator must have a usable volume of at least 510 litres.

requirements.summary_uz: Uskunalar yangi bo'lishi, ishlab chiqarilgan yili 2026 yildan oldin bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Equipment must be new, with a manufacture year not earlier than 2026.
requirements.quote: Год выпуска товара - не ранее 2026 года

requirements.summary_uz: Mahalliy ijrochilar uchun yetkazib berish muddati oldindan to'lov kunidan 90 kun.
requirements.summary_en: For domestic suppliers, delivery is within 90 days of the advance payment.
requirements.quote: Для отечественных исполнителей: 90 дней со дня проведения предоплаты.

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat muddati foydalanishga topshirilgandan kamida 24 oy.
requirements.summary_en: Warranty of at least 24 months from commissioning.
requirements.quote: Гарантийный срок со дня сдачи в эксплуатацию: не менее 24 месяцев

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif topshirish paytida Dori vositalari xavfsizligi markazining amaldagi ro'yxatdan o'tish guvohnomasi (yoki ro'yxatdan o'tish boshlanganligi haqida xat) bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At the time of bidding a valid registration certificate from the pharmaceutical safety centre (or a letter that registration has started) is required.
requirements.quote: На момент подачи предложения наличие действующего регистрационного удостоверения, выданного Государственным Учреждением

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi o'z servis markazi yoki ishlab chiqaruvchi vakolat bergan servis markazi bilan kelishuv nusxasini taqdim etishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must show its own service centre or a copy of an agreement with a manufacturer-authorised service centre.
requirements.quote: Участник торгов в рамках своего предложения должен предоставить информацию о наличии своего сервис центра

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchi zavod avtorizatsiyasi mavjud bo'lsa 1 ball beriladi; yo'q bo'lsa ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmagan ishtirokchi chetlashtiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Manufacturer authorisation earns 1 point; a non-manufacturer without it is excluded.
requirements.quote: Ишлаб чиқарувчи завод авторизациясининг мавжудлиги (харид иштирокчиси таклиф этилаётган товар ишлаб чиқарувчиси бўлмаган тақдирда)

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib berish muddatini 75 foizga qisqartirish 2 ball beradi (ballarning jami 19 dan 2 tasi).
requirements.summary_en: Shortening the delivery term by 75 percent gives 2 points (2 of 19 in total).
requirements.quote: Етказиб бериш муддатлари белгиланган муддатнинг камида 75 фоизга қисқартирилганда 2 балл

flags.quote: Точность поддержания температуры при +25 °C окружающей среды ±2.2 °C при -41 °C и +25 °C
flags.explanation_uz: Past haroratli muzlatkich uchun ish harorati diapazoni -40...-32 C deb berilgan, ammo aniqlik -41 C da ±2,2 C ko'rsatilgan, ya'ni diapazondan tashqarida. Shovqin darajasi ham ikki tomonlama tor oraliqda (60-61 dB) belgilangan, sovutgich uchun 47-51 dB. Bunday kombinatsiya bitta modelning pasportidan olinganga o'xshaydi va talabga mos boshqa uskunalarni chetlatishi mumkin; hujjatning o'zi mahalliy takliflar texnik talablarga mos kelmaydi deb qayd etgan.
flags.explanation_en: For the low-temperature freezer the operating range is -40 to -32 C, yet accuracy is stated at -41 C, outside that range. Noise is fixed in a two-sided narrow band (60-61 dB, and 47-51 dB for the refrigerator). The combination looks lifted from one model's data sheet and may exclude otherwise suitable devices; the document itself notes that local offers do not match the technical requirements.
flags.rewrite_uz: Harorat bir xilligi va aniqligi: ish diapazonida (-40...-32 C) ±3 C dan oshmasligi; shovqin darajasi: 65 dB(A) dan oshmasligi (sovutgich uchun 55 dB(A) dan oshmasligi).
flags.rewrite_en: Temperature uniformity and accuracy: no worse than ±3 C within the working range (-40 to -32 C); noise level: not above 65 dB(A) (not above 55 dB(A) for the refrigerator).

flags.quote: Харид иштирокчиси таклиф этилаётган товар ишлаб чиқарувчиси бўлмаган тақдирда 5-шаклга мувофиқ расмийлаштирилади. Агар мавжуд бўлмаса, иштирокчи тендерда қатнашишдан четлаштирилади.
flags.explanation_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmagan ishtirokchi uchun zavod avtorizatsiyasi 1 ball beradi, lekin uni topshirmaslik tenderdan chetlatishga olib keladi. Ya'ni 1 ballli mezon amalda majburiy talabga aylangan va 10,66 mlrd so'mlik lotda mustaqil yetkazib beruvchilar chetlashishi mumkin. Servis va kafolat boshqa hujjatlar bilan ham tasdiqlanishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: For a bidder that is not the manufacturer, factory authorisation earns 1 point, yet omitting it means exclusion from the tender. The one-point criterion thus acts as a mandatory condition, and independent suppliers on this 10.66 billion UZS lot could be shut out. Service and warranty could also be proved by other documents.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmasa, avtorizatsiya xatini yoki kafolat va servis majburiyatlarini tasdiqlovchi boshqa hujjatni (masalan, servis markazi bilan shartnoma) topshirishi mumkin; avtorizatsiya xati bo'lmasa, ishtirokchi chetlashtirilmaydi, faqat 1 ball olmaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: If the bidder is not the manufacturer, it may submit an authorisation letter or another document proving warranty and service commitments (for example a contract with a service centre); lack of an authorisation letter does not lead to exclusion, only to losing the 1 point.

documents_needed_uz: Taklif etilayotgan modelning texnik hujjatlari (broshyura, pasport, foydalanish qo'llanmasi) va har bir band bo'yicha asoslovchi havola
Dori vositalari xavfsizligi markazining ro'yxatdan o'tish guvohnomasi yoki ro'yxatdan o'tish boshlanganligi haqida xat
ISO 13485 sertifikati nusxasi (va mavjud bo'lsa CE sertifikati)
Ishlab chiqaruvchi avtorizatsiyasi (5-shakl), agar ishtirokchi ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmasa
Servis markazi to'g'risida ma'lumot yoki servis markazi bilan shartnoma
Kafolat muddatini va yetkazib berish muddatini tasdiqlovchi kafolat xatlari
Soliq organlariga topshirilgan oxirgi moliyaviy hisobotlar (balans, moliyaviy natijalar)
Ta'sis hujjatlari va davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi
Soliq qarzi yo'qligi, insofsiz ijrochilar reestrida yo'qligi va majburiy ijro byurosi bo'yicha ma'lumotlar
